calibration.measurement: de-duplicated allocations, planner picks plus random allocations spanning the simplex (docs/E0_diagnosis.md)

direction_specificity.null: permutation over the other candidate directions

2_set_utility_beats_additive.rule: additive-head / set-head MSE on the WITHIN-checkpoint gain > 1

3_latent_neighbors_similar_effects.rule: neighbour effect distance / random effect distance < 1

4_beam_matches_exact.note: when the full candidate set is too large to enumerate, this is measured on a small sub-problem of the top directions

6_metadata_moves_latents.rule: mean gap cos(desired, realized) - mean|cos(desired, other candidates)| >= 0.3. A raw cosine is uninterpretable when the latent space is collapsed, and dividing by the null's spread (a z-score) breaks both when the directions are near-identical (the spread vanishes and z explodes) and when they are orthogonal (the spread also vanishes, but that is the best case). 0.3 is ~1.5x the measured replicate noise of the realized cosine (~0.2).
